founders.name: Abhay Gupta
founders.bio: Abhay Gupta began his career as a hardware chip designer at Sun Microsystems before moving into product management roles at Echelon and Grid Net, where he focused on sensor networks and smart grid technology. These experiences in the nascent smart meter industry inspired him to co-found Bidgely in 2011 to solve the 'disaggregation' problem—using AI to identify individual appliance energy usage from a single data point. He has since led the company to secure over $75M in funding and holds more than 16 patents in energy analytics.
education: B.Tech, Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Delhi
M.S. Electrical Engineering, University of Southern California
MBA, Santa Clara University

founders.name: Vivek Garud
founders.bio: Before co-founding Bidgely in 2011, Vivek Garud spent a significant portion of his early career at Microsoft, where he contributed to the development of voice recognition technology. A graduate of the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Bombay, he transitioned from big tech to the startup world to apply machine learning and big data analytics to global energy problems. Outside of his technical leadership, Vivek is a passionate musician who harbors a long-term goal of composing music for the Bollywood film industry.
education: B.Tech in Computer Science, IIT Bombay

founders.name: Simon Koopmann
founders.bio: Simon Koopmann is an engineer and researcher who co-founded envelio in 2017 as a spin-off from RWTH Aachen University's Institute for High Voltage Technology. He spent over a decade at the university, progressing from a student to a Research Associate and finally the Team Leader for Distributed Energy Systems. His pre-founding experience also includes strategic and technical roles at Siemens and RWE AG, where he focused on the practical integration of renewable energy into power grids.
education: Dr.-Ing. in Electrical Power Engineering, RWTH Aachen University
Diplom-Wirtschaftsingenieur (Dipl.-Wirt.-Ing.) in Electrical Power Engineering and Management, RWTH Aachen University
UNITECH International Scholarship Program
Study Abroad in Industrial Engineering, Chalmers University of Technology

founders.name: Philipp Erlinghagen
founders.bio: Philipp Erlinghagen is a co-founder of envelio, a clean-tech spin-off from RWTH Aachen University. Before founding the company in 2017, he spent nearly a decade at the university's Institute for High Voltage Technology (IFHT) as a doctoral student and research associate. His academic research into grid stability and the digital management of distributed energy sources formed the technical foundation for envelio's Intelligent Grid Platform. He also gained early industrial experience through technical internships at RWE and Maschinenfabrik Reinhausen.
education: Doctor of Engineering (Dr.-Ing.) in Electrical Engineering, RWTH Aachen University (2019)
Master of Science (M.Sc.) in Electrical Engineering, Information Technology and Computer Engineering, RWTH Aachen University (2013)
Master of Science (M.Sc.) in Electrical Energy Engineering and Business Administration, RWTH Aachen University (2012)
Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) in Electrical Energy Engineering and Business Administration, RWTH Aachen University (2010)

founders.name: Fabian Potratz
founders.bio: Fabian Potratz spent nearly a decade at RWTH Aachen University, progressing from a research associate to the head of sustainable distribution systems. During his tenure at the university's Institute for High Voltage Technology, his doctoral research on grid planning and automation served as the technical foundation for envelio’s Intelligent Grid Platform. Prior to founding the company as a spin-out in 2017, he gained extensive industry experience through internships at major energy firms such as EnBW and local utilities like Stadtwerke Aachen. As CTO, he leads the development of software solutions designed to digitize and automate power grid management for the energy transition.
education: Bachelor of Science in Electrical Power Engineering and Management, RWTH Aachen University
Doctorate in Engineering (Dr.-Ing.) in Electrical Power Engineering, RWTH Aachen University

founders.name: Philipp Goergens
founders.bio: Philipp Goergens is a co-founder of envelio, where he serves as VP Engineering and previously led software development. Prior to founding the company in 2017, he was a Research Associate and Team Leader for Distributed Energy Systems at the Institute for High Voltage Technology (IAEW) at RWTH Aachen University. His academic research focused on distributed energy systems and smart grid optimization, forming the technical basis for envelio's Intelligent Grid Platform.
education: PhD (Dr.-Ing.) in Engineering, RWTH Aachen University
Master's Degree, RWTH Aachen University

founders.name: Moritz Cramer
founders.role: Co-Founder and Vice President of Customer Success
founders.bio: Dr. Moritz Cramer co-founded envelio in 2017 as a spin-off from the Institute for High Voltage Technology (IFHT) at RWTH Aachen University. Between 2012 and 2017, he served as a Research Assistant and Head of Department for Grid Planning and Operation at the institute, where he led the development of the 'Intelligent Grid Platform' (IGP). His pre-founding career also includes technical internships at Siemens Energy and the South African utility Eskom. His research and professional background focus on the automation of power grid planning to support the integration of renewable energy.
education: PhD in Engineering, RWTH Aachen University
Dipl.-Wirt.-Ing. in Engineering/Industrial Management, RWTH Aachen University
Electrical and Electronics Engineering (Exchange), KTH Royal Institute of Technology

founders.name: Gregory R. Wolfe
founders.bio: Gregory R. Wolfe began his career in 1986 as a Senior Electrical Engineer at Texas Instruments, where he worked on Advanced Defense Weapons Systems. He later served as the Director of Operations for McDonald Technologies before joining Megger, a leader in electrical test equipment, as an Executive Vice President for 14 years. In 2014, he co-founded Fischer Block to leverage his extensive background in power engineering and predictive analytics to develop 'intelligence at the edge' solutions for the electrical grid. Wolfe is an active member of the IEEE, holds multiple patents in power system analytics, and is a certified Six Sigma Black Belt.
education: Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering, Michigan State University

founders.name: Margaret Paietta
founders.role: Co-founder, Director of Strategic Accounts & CMO
founders.bio: Margaret Paietta began her career in 1982 as the first female software engineer at Singer's Link/Avionics Division in Silicon Valley, specializing in flight simulation systems. She later transitioned into entrepreneurship, founding Casual American Sportswear LLC in 2002 and Utility Staffing Associates, an energy-focused executive recruiting firm, in 2009. In 2013, she co-founded Fischer Block, Inc., where she combines her technical background with executive leadership to drive marketing and strategic accounts for smart grid analytics.
education: Bachelor of Science in Psychology and Computer Science, Santa Clara University

founders.name: Brage W. Johansen
founders.role: Co-founder and former CEO of Heimdall Power
founders.bio: Brage W. Johansen is a prolific Norwegian serial entrepreneur with over two decades of experience in the energy, space, and green tech industries. Prior to founding Heimdall Power, he spent over ten years at Statoil (now Equinor), where he served as the Head of Hydrogen and led the development of Norway's first 24/7 hydrogen station and the hydrogen-powered sports car concept, FYK. He subsequently co-founded and served as CEO of electric vehicle charging leader Zaptec and the desert-greening startup Desert Control. An engineer with a deep passion for space exploration, Johansen also serves on the board of the Mars Institute and has secured a ticket for a future spaceflight.
education: Master of Science, Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU)
Technology Management, NTNU / NHH
Executive Course, International Space University
Singularity University

founders.name: Alan Wong
founders.bio: Professor Alan Wong is a leading expert in High Voltage Engineering and the inventor of the Early Fault Detection (EFD) system, which he developed at RMIT University before spinning it out into IND Technology in 2013. Prior to founding the company, his career was focused on academic research at RMIT, where he patented the core IP for a 'smoke alarm' for power networks designed to predict and prevent catastrophic electrical fires. In addition to his leadership at IND Technology, he continues to serve as a Professor at RMIT and is the President of the Hundred School Project, a non-profit organization dedicated to improving educational access for children in remote and disadvantaged communities.
education: PhD in Electrical Engineering, RMIT University

founders.name: Kokwai Leu
founders.bio: Kokwai Leu is the Co-Founder and CFO of IND Technology, a grid intelligence startup he helped launch in 2013 in the aftermath of Australia's Black Saturday bushfires. He brings over 20 years of experience in investment banking, corporate strategy, and finance to the company, having previously held senior roles in the corporate sector and at professional services firms like Coopers & Lybrand. Partnering with RMIT Professor Alan Wong, Leu has been instrumental in transitioning the company from a Victorian-based operation to a global provider of early fault detection systems. His financial leadership was recently critical in securing a $50 million funding round to scale AI-driven powerline safety solutions internationally.
education: Monash University
ACCA (Association of Chartered Certified Accountants)

founders.name: Greg Jackson
founders.role: Founder of Kraken Technologies and CEO of Octopus Energy Group
founders.bio: Greg Jackson is a serial entrepreneur who began his career as a self-taught computer programmer and video game developer at age 16 before returning to education. Prior to founding Octopus Energy and its proprietary tech platform Kraken in 2015, he built and sold several successful ventures including the e-commerce firm C360 and the telemedicine provider Consultant Connect. His drive to disrupt the energy sector was heavily influenced by a working-class upbringing where he experienced the direct impact of high energy costs, including having his power cut off as a child.
education: BA in Economics, University of Cambridge (Pembroke College)

founders.name: James Eddison
founders.bio: Before co-founding Octopus Energy and architecting its Kraken platform, James Eddison was a seasoned tech leader and e-commerce specialist who served as the CTO of digital agency Tangent Labs for ten years. His early career included a tenure as CEO of the web-conferencing startup Claripoint and a consultant role helping Unilever navigate Y2K compliance. Eddison met his future Octopus co-founders at the University of Cambridge, where they collaborated on their first ventures as students before eventually reuniting to disrupt the global energy market with proprietary cloud technology.
education: Engineering, University of Cambridge

founders.name: Ryan Porter
founders.bio: Before co-founding LiveView Technologies (LVT) in 2005, Ryan Porter worked as a construction loan officer in the finance industry, where he identified a market need for remote surveillance on residential construction sites. Originally from Southern California, he moved to Utah to attend college and used his finance background to bootstrap LVT in its early years, even mortgaging his home to sustain operations. Under his leadership, the company evolved from a small garage startup into a leading provider of mobile, cloud-based security units for global retail and government sectors.
education: BS in Finance, Utah Valley University

founders.name: Bob Brenner
founders.bio: Founder of LVT.

founders.name: Ben Brown
founders.bio: Ben Brown spent 12 years at Google, where he served as a key product leader for Google Nest, Google Home, and Google Wifi. He most recently worked in Google Labs, where he led the development of vertically focused Large Language Models. Before Google, Brown was a serial entrepreneur who founded and sold MakeMeSustainable, Inc., an early smart home energy management startup. He has also held product leadership roles at Noveda Technologies and worked as an analyst at Charles River Associates.
education: BA in Mathematics & Economics, Wesleyan University
MBA in Entrepreneurship & Product Development, Columbia Business School

founders.name: Jonathan Winer
founders.bio: Prior to co-founding Renew Home, Jonathan Winer was the Head of Investments at Alphabet’s urban innovation platform, Sidewalk Labs, where he managed funds across technology, real estate, and infrastructure. He has over two decades of experience in private equity and infrastructure, having founded Nereus Capital and built the private equity team at the D. E. Shaw Group. Winer began his career as a technical entrepreneur, founding startups in the fields of natural language processing and computational biochemistry.
education: Bachelor of Arts in Philosophy, Yale University
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Yale University

founders.name: Matt Duesterberg
founders.bio: Matt Duesterberg began his career as a quantitative energy trader at DC Energy, where he traded electricity futures before transitioning into data analytics. He served as the Director of Data Science at DataRaker, leading the division through its acquisition by Oracle in 2013. In 2014, he co-founded OhmConnect to create a residential virtual power plant platform, eventually leading the company through a 2024 merger with Google Nest’s Renew service to form Renew Home.
education: BS in Chemical Engineering, University of Virginia
MS in Mechanical Engineering (Energy Systems focus), Stanford University

founders.name: Cadir Lee
founders.bio: Cadir Lee is a self-taught software engineer who transitioned from a pre-medical track to technology after discovering a passion for coding during a Stanford elective. He began his career as a prolific developer at Spaceworks before co-founding Support.com (formerly SupportSoft), which he led through a successful IPO in 2000. Lee later served as the CTO of Zynga during its era of massive growth and transition to a public company. Prior to forming Renew Home, he co-founded and served as President and CTO of OhmConnect, a clean energy platform dedicated to solving the climate crisis.
education: B.S. in Biological Sciences, Stanford University
B.A. in Music, Stanford University

founders.name: Curtis Tongue
founders.bio: Curtis Tongue co-founded Renew Home following the 2024 merger of OhmConnect and Google’s Nest Renew. After graduating from UC Berkeley with a degree in Molecular and Cellular Biology, he initially pursued a career in advertising, serving as an Account Director at Bleu Marketing Solutions. Driven by a desire to address climate change, he pivoted to climate tech, first founding the sustainability startup karbonkarma in 2012 before launching the virtual power plant platform OhmConnect in 2014.
education: Bachelor of Arts in Molecular and Cellular Biology, University of California, Berkeley

founders.name: Jussi Hakunti
founders.role: President of Safegrid USA and Co-founder
founders.bio: A veteran engineer and serial entrepreneur, Jussi Hakunti spent over a decade at Nokia (1995–2006) as a lead mechanical engineer, where he was famously responsible for the mechanism of the interchangeable Xpress-on covers for the Nokia 5110 and the signature 'smiley face' hidden in internal phone speaker designs. Following his tenure at Nokia, he founded and led several technology ventures, including UNIQOTEQ, MeBeGood, and Nidos Ltd., and served as a director at Axel Technologies. In 2019, he co-founded Safegrid, serving as CEO until 2023, and now leads the company's expansion into the American market as President of Safegrid USA.
education: Degree in Mechanical Engineering

founders.name: Jyrki Penttonen
founders.bio: Dr. Jyrki Penttonen was a researcher and entrepreneur who specialized in high-voltage engineering and smart grid technologies. Before co-founding Safegrid, he spent years at Aalto University's Department of Electrical Engineering, where his doctoral research focused on magnetically controlled reactors and smart grid optimization. He previously served as a technical lead at Viola Systems, a pioneer in wireless communication for electric grids that was later integrated into ABB solutions. Penttonen co-founded Safegrid to commercialize advanced grid monitoring systems and later founded Vensum Ltd in 2018 to further innovate in power conversion technology.
education: PhD in Electrical Engineering, Aalto University
Master of Science in Electrical Engineering, Aalto University

founders.name: Adam Bry
founders.bio: Adam Bry is the co-founder and CEO of Skydio, having built a career centered on autonomous flight and robotics. Before starting Skydio, he co-founded Google [x]'s Project Wing, where he led the development of core flight control and navigation algorithms. His technical foundation was laid at the MIT CSAIL Robust Robotics Group, where he pioneered research on high-speed autonomous flight in GPS-denied environments. A lifelong aviation enthusiast, Bry was a national champion R/C aerobatics pilot before translating his physical flight intuition into world-class software systems.
education: BS in Mechanical Engineering, Franklin W. Olin College of Engineering
MS in Computer Science and Aerospace Engineering, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT)

founders.name: Abe Bachrach
founders.bio: Abe Bachrach was a founding member of Google [x]'s Project Wing, where he helped develop the early infrastructure for autonomous delivery drones. Before joining Google, he conducted groundbreaking research at MIT’s Robust Robotics Group, focusing on enabling drones to navigate complex, GPS-denied environments using SLAM. His personal story is rooted in the San Francisco Bay Area, where he and his co-founders famously incubated Skydio in his father’s basement and tested early prototypes in the backyard. Bachrach has since transitioned his academic expertise in trajectory estimation and perception into Skydio’s core autonomy engine.
education: BS in Electrical Engineering and Computer Sciences, UC Berkeley
PhD in Trajectory Bundle Estimation for Perception-Driven Planning, MIT

founders.name: Matt Donahoe
founders.bio: Before co-founding Skydio in 2014, Matt Donahoe was a Mobile Engineer at Pocket Gems, where he was the primary creator and developer of the 'Episode' interactive storytelling platform. He previously served as a Research Assistant at the MIT Media Lab, where he focused on the intersection of media arts and technical innovation. His early career also included roles at The MITRE Corporation and software work at Olin College, blending a strong engineering foundation with a specialized focus on product design and user experience.
previous_companies: Franklin W. Olin College of Engineering
education: Master of Science in Media Arts and Sciences, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT)
Bachelor of Science in Engineering, Franklin W. Olin College of Engineering

founders.name: Deepak Garg
founders.bio: Deepak Garg founded Smart Energy Water (SEW) after a twenty-year career in product development and engineering leadership at Fortune 500 companies. Before launching SEW, he held senior executive positions at DXC Technology and HCL Technologies, where he led the creation of large-scale business solutions that generated hundreds of millions in revenue. His transition from corporate engineering to entrepreneurship was driven by a vision to utilize AI and IoT to solve global energy and water sustainability issues. He is a recognized leader in the Orange County tech ecosystem and a frequent contributor to the Forbes Technology Council.
education: MS in Computer Science
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering
Executive Management, Stanford Graduate Business School
Executive Management, MIT
tags: EY Entrepreneur of the Year Finalist

founders.name: Nate Walkingshaw
founders.bio: Nate Walkingshaw began his career as an EMT, an experience that inspired him to invent a revolutionary medical evacuation system called Paraslyde and found his first company, Paramed (later acquired by Stryker Medical). He went on to found Brightface, where he developed the fitness app Cycleface which was acquired by Strava, before serving as the Chief of Research and Innovation at Tanner Labs. Prior to founding Torus, he spent six years as the Chief Product Officer and Chief Experience Officer at Pluralsight, where he oversaw the company's product, engineering, and content teams through its 2018 IPO. A pioneer of the 'Directed Discovery' methodology, Walkingshaw is also a co-author of the industry-standard book 'Product Leadership.'
education: Waterford School
Westminster University

founders.name: Gilbert Lee
founders.bio: Gilbert Lee spent over two decades in tech leadership before co-founding Torus in 2021. He previously served as VP of Product and User Experience at Pluralsight, where he helped scale the product and engineering teams alongside his now-co-founder Nate Walkingshaw during the company's growth toward its IPO. His extensive background also includes senior design and product roles at organizations like Domo, O.C. Tanner, and Northrop Grumman Mission Systems. Originally from the Philippines, Lee immigrated to the United States and built a career focused on human-centered design and complex product strategy.
previous_companies: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
education: Bachelor's Degree in Business Management and Information Systems, Brigham Young University
International Business, Brigham Young University-Hawaii
Ateneo de Manila University

founders.name: Dr. William Burke
founders.bio: Prior to founding Virtual Peaker, Dr. William Burke served as an Advanced Systems Engineer in the Connected Home Software Group at GE and was the CEO of the startup Calculingua. He spent over a decade specializing in residential energy management, building on his doctoral research at UC Berkeley which focused on using smart thermostats to manage grid demand. His professional background also includes experience as an algorithm consultant for EcoFactor and a graduate researcher in AI and controls. His transition into entrepreneurship was fueled by a personal commitment to climate action following his daughter's premature birth, which redefined his focus on building a sustainable legacy.
education: PhD in Mechanical Engineering, University of California, Berkeley
BS in Mechanical Engineering, University of Kentucky

founders.name: Alexander P. Sator
founders.bio: Alexander P. Sator is a serial entrepreneur and technical inventor who co-founded his first software company in 1983 while still a teenager. After a career in the scientific industry, he founded Sator Laser in 1996, growing it into a market leader before selling it to Domino Printing Science Plc in 2001. He subsequently led 4G Systems to an acquisition by Deutsche Telekom in 2006 and spent several years as a strategic advisor for the carrier and chairman of Cinterion Wireless Modules before launching 1NCE in 2018.
education: Degree in Physics

founders.name: Kim Juchem
founders.bio: Kim Juchem is a telecommunications industry veteran with over 20 years of experience, particularly within the Deutsche Telekom Group. Before co-founding 1NCE in 2017, he spent over a decade at Deutsche Telekom and T-Mobile in high-level leadership roles, including Vice President of Commercial Roaming and VP of Investment Management. His earlier career involved consulting for Detecon International, where he focused on international wholesale and strategic partnerships. Juchem’s deep expertise in global roaming and connectivity infrastructure was instrumental in establishing 1NCE’s disruptive flat-rate IoT connectivity model.
education: Master’s Degree in Telecommunication Business and Economics, University of Duisburg-Essen
MBA, Indiana University of Pennsylvania

founders.name: Amitai Ratzon
founders.bio: Before leading Pentera to unicorn status, Amitai Ratzon spent over 15 years as a go-to-market specialist, scaling global sales organizations for early-stage fintech ventures. He held senior sales leadership roles at Earnix and SuperDerivatives (now part of ICE), where he focused on selling complex enterprise software to global financial institutions. His professional journey began with service as a combat officer in the Israel Defense Forces, followed by a formative period in New York managing a sales team for Yellow Pages advertisements. He was eventually recruited in 2017 to transition Pentera from its stealth phase into a global leader in Automated Security Validation.
education: LL.B, Reichman University
BA in Business Administration, Reichman University
International Executive MBA, Kellogg-Recanati (Northwestern University & Tel Aviv University)

founders.name: Yoav Cohen
founders.bio: Yoav Cohen is the Co-founder and COO of 4M Analytics. Before founding the company in 2019, he served for over 20 years in the Israeli Defense Forces, concluding his career as the Commander (Colonel) of Unit 9900, the elite geospatial-intelligence agency responsible for satellite imagery and mapping. His background in military intelligence and large-scale engineering initiatives led him to co-found 4M Defense (now 4M Group), a company specializing in remote minefield detection, which eventually pivoted to the subsurface utility mapping technology that defines 4M Analytics today.
education: Technion - Israel Institute of Technology

founders.name: Nir Cohen
founders.bio: Nir Cohen's career began in the Israel Defense Forces, where he served as a commander in the elite Yahalom unit, specializing in subsurface operations and covert engineering initiatives. Following his military service, he held a professional role at Elbit Systems before reuniting with fellow veteran Itzik Malka to launch a mine clearance contracting venture. This humanitarian-focused effort eventually evolved into 4M Analytics, where Cohen leverages his deep expertise in 'working with the earth' to lead the company's delivery of AI-powered subsurface infrastructure mapping.
education: Undergraduate Studies, The Open University of Israel

founders.name: Ophir Wainer
founders.role: Director of North American Business Development
founders.bio: Ophir Wainer is a veteran utility professional with over 25 years of experience in Subsurface Utility Engineering (SUE) and project management. Before joining 4M Analytics in 2021 to lead their North American expansion, he was a Senior Principal at T2 Utility Engineers, where he specialized in solving complex subsurface conflicts. He is a prominent industry advocate, having co-founded the Canadian chapters of the UESI and served as Chair of NASTT-BC, earning him the nickname 'The Fixer' for his expertise in utility investigation and damage prevention.
education: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.)

founders.name: Alfredo Rivela
founders.bio: Alfredo Rivela is a seasoned serial entrepreneur and computer engineer who has been a prominent figure in the Spanish technology sector since the 1990s. In 1995, he founded KABEL, a leading digital transformation consultancy and top Microsoft partner, which he served as Chairman for over 25 years until its acquisition by Avanade (Accenture) in 2022. Throughout his career, he has launched multiple ventures including Nomaders, Local_Heroes, and TurningTables, and was a key early investor and board member at BuyVIP, which was eventually acquired by Amazon. His move to found ADAION in 2023 represents a culmination of his technical expertise and business acumen applied to the challenges of smart grid and energy infrastructure.
education: Master's degree in Computer Science and Telecommunications, Universidad Politécnica de Madrid
PDD (Program of Management Development), IESE Business School - University of Navarra
Executive Education in Product Management and Entrepreneurship, Stanford University
Executive Program in Exponential Technologies, Singularity University

founders.name: Mike Gulla
founders.bio: Mike Gulla is an insurance industry veteran with over 20 years of experience in the property and casualty sector. Before co-founding Adaptive Insurance, he was the first insurance hire at Hippo Insurance, where he served as Director of Underwriting and helped scale the company to over 30 states. His career is marked by a focus on digital innovation, having led the underwriting development for Esurance's first direct-to-consumer online bindable home insurance quote. Gulla's foundational experience includes catastrophe management at Nationwide Mutual Insurance, where he managed responses to major weather events like the 2011 Tuscaloosa tornadoes.
education: Bachelor's degree in Political Science and American Politics, Troy University

founders.name: Arik Yelovitch
founders.bio: Arik Yelovitch began his career as a software engineer and group manager at HP Software in Israel, where he spent seven years honing his technical leadership skills. In 2016, he joined Hippo Insurance as an early engineering leader, playing a pivotal role in the company's growth prior to its public listing. He later served as the Chief Technology Officer at Delos Insurance Solutions, where he utilized satellite imagery and data science to address wildfire risk. Yelovitch has also held management positions at Credit Karma and Hewlett Packard Enterprise, establishing a deep expertise in insurance technology and platform management before co-founding Adaptive Insurance in 2024.
education: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Ben-Gurion University of the Negev

founders.name: Ray Bell
founders.bio: Before founding Aetheros in 2019, Ray Bell was a prominent figure in Silicon Valley, serving as the CTO for Cisco's first Internet business unit and a Vice President and CTO at Oracle in the early 1990s. A prolific serial entrepreneur, he previously co-founded Silver Spring Networks in 2003 to pioneer IP-based advanced metering infrastructure and served as the founder and CEO of both SmartPipes and Grid Net. Aetheros was established by acquiring product technologies from Grid Net to focus on building a distributed network operating system for the next generation of smart grid and IoT edge computing.
education: Bachelor of Arts (BA) in Political Science, University of California, Berkeley

founders.name: Abhishek Singh
founders.bio: Abhishek Singh is a serial entrepreneur with nearly two decades of experience in building innovation-led products and scaling global technology businesses. His journey in the startup ecosystem began in 2005 when he co-founded Skan DbyDx Software, a mobility solutions company he led as CEO until its successful merger with Kellton Tech in 2012. Following the acquisition, he served as the COO (USA) and Head of Digital Transformation at Kellton Tech and was a key co-founder of the online education platform Edureka. Before founding AiDash in 2019, he was instrumental in the growth of multiple tech ventures and established a reputation for driving digital transformation in core infrastructure industries.
education: B.Tech in Chemical Engineering, IIT Kanpur

founders.name: Rahul Saxena
founders.role: Chief Product & Technology Officer and Co-Founder
founders.bio: Before co-founding AiDash, Rahul Saxena accumulated over 20 years of experience in product development and engineering, with a specialized focus on enterprise security and analytics. He held senior engineering leadership roles at RSA Security and Qwest Software Services, where he managed large-scale software development for Fortune 500 companies. A serial entrepreneur, he previously co-founded the fintech startup Quiklo and the digital platform allMemoirs, bringing a seasoned perspective on scaling technology ventures from zero to one. His career has been defined by a deep interest in leveraging AI and machine learning to solve complex industrial efficiency problems.
education: Bachelor's Degree, Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Delhi

founders.name: Nitin Das
founders.bio: Hailing from Jabalpur, India, Nitin Das developed a childhood fascination with electronics by dismantling household gadgets before pursuing a Computer Science degree at IIT Delhi. He began his entrepreneurial journey in 2008 by co-founding Uvaca and later served as the first employee and Director of Applied Research at Kvantum, which was eventually acquired by Yum! Brands. Before co-founding AiDash, he led advanced AI initiatives as a Lead AI Scientist at Target, specializing in deep learning and retail analytics. His technical background spans over 18 years, with a consistent focus on building AI/ML stacks for real-world enterprise applications.
education: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering, IIT Delhi

founders.name: Charlotte Wang
founders.bio: Growing up in a Chinese village adjacent to coal-fired power plants, Wang suffered from chronic respiratory issues that only resolved after she moved to the United States for college. This personal experience with pollution fueled her mission to use her background in computer science and system design to modernize traditional power grids. Before founding AIon Grid Inc. as a spin-out of her first venture, EQuota Energy, she gained professional experience at the Washington State Government, China Development Bank, and Fraunhofer, and served as a researcher at MIT.
education: B.A. in Computer Science, Dordt College
M.Sc. in Computer Science, University of Washington
M.Sc. in System Design and Management, MIT
Yale World Fellow, Yale University

founders.name: Jeremy Friedland
founders.bio: A design leader who spent eight years at Facebook (Meta) leading pillars for Groups and News Feed before joining DoorDash. He began his tech career in visual merchandising at an Apple Store while studying psychology, later transitioning into advanced research at the University of Washington's HCI lab. His work focuses on 'algorithmic living' and crafting research-grounded solutions for consumer engagement and growth.
education: MS in Human-Computer Interaction, University of Washington
BS in Psychology, University of Michigan

founders.name: José Delgado
founders.bio: Prior to founding American Transmission Company (ATC) in 2001, José Delgado spent 27 years at Wisconsin Electric Power Co. (now We Energies), where he rose to become the Vice President of Electric System Operations. He famously oversaw the formation of ATC as the first multi-state transmission-only utility in the United States, managing its operations until his retirement in 2010. His personal story is one of resilience, having immigrated to the U.S. from Cuba at age 14 as part of 'Operation Peter Pan' before building a career as a leading figure in the American electrical utility industry.
education: B.S. Electrical Engineering, Marquette University
M.S. Electrical Engineering, University of Wisconsin-Milwaukee
MBA, University of Wisconsin-Milwaukee

founders.name: Jean-Louis Lilien
founders.bio: Jean-Louis Lilien is a leading academic and engineer who spent over three decades at the University of Liège specializing in the dynamics of overhead power lines. His extensive research into cable vibrations and mechanical frequency detection led to the invention of the Ampacimon sensor, which monitors power line sag in real time. In 2010, he transitioned his lab-based breakthroughs into the commercial sector by co-founding Ampacimon as a university spin-off. Before founding the company, he served as the Head of the Transmission and Distribution of Electrical Energy unit and worked as a consulting engineer for SAMTECH.
education: PhD in Electrical and Mechanical Engineering, University of Liège (1984)
Degree in Electrical and Mechanical Engineering, University of Liège (1976)

founders.name: Jacques Destiné
founders.bio: Jacques Destiné is a Professor of Microelectronics at the University of Liège's Montefiore Institute, where he has served as a faculty member since 1985. Prior to founding Ampacimon, he focused on the research and development of microsystems for industrial and biomedical applications, co-founding the Microsys laboratory in 2006. His extensive background in semiconductor packaging and sensors also led him to co-found the spin-off Taipro Engineering in 2009, establishing a bridge between academic research and commercial industrial electronics.
education: Electrical Engineering Degree, University of Liège (1972)
Doctorate in Applied Sciences (Ph.D.), University of Liège (1985)

founders.name: David Almroth
founders.bio: David Almroth is an experienced entrepreneur and engineer with over 20 years of experience in software development and machine learning. Before co-founding Arkion (formerly Skyqraft) in 2019, he served as the CTO of MuchDifferent, a gaming technology startup where he developed a massively scalable network solution that achieved a Guinness World Record for the most players in a first-person shooter game. He also has a deep background in the energy sector, having worked with major utilities such as Vattenfall and E.ON, which informed his mission to automate power grid inspections using AI and drones.
education: Computer Science, Telecommunications, and Economics (Stockholm University/KTH)

founders.name: Umar Chughtai
founders.bio: Before co-founding Arkion Solutions AB (formerly Skyqraft), Umar Chughtai spent several years as a researcher and machine learning developer at the KTH Smart Mobility Lab in Stockholm, where he specialized in drone robotics and autonomous systems. He holds a degree in aerospace engineering and moved to Sweden to pursue advanced studies in embedded systems after a lifelong passion for aviation led him from Lahore to the United States. His transition into entrepreneurship was catalyzed by his work at KTH, where he recognized the potential for using AI-driven drones to revolutionize power grid infrastructure inspections.
education: BS in Aerospace Engineering, University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign
MS in Embedded Systems, KTH Royal Institute of Technology

founders.name: Sakina Turabali
founders.bio: Sakina Turabali is a Sri Lankan-born entrepreneur who moved to Stockholm, where she established herself as a growth and marketing expert within the Swedish tech ecosystem. Prior to founding Arkion Solutions, she played a pivotal role at Truecaller, helping the startup scale its global user base from 30,000 to over 100 million users. Her diverse pre-founding career includes marketing leadership roles at Atchik and zMessenger, as well as founding the boutique brand 'Gonuts with Donuts' in Sri Lanka. She eventually joined the Antler startup generator in Stockholm to find technical partners, which led to the 2019 launch of her infrastructure AI company, originally known as Skyqraft.
education: Professional Diploma in Marketing, The Chartered Institute of Marketing (CIM)

founders.name: David Wickström
founders.bio: Prior to co-founding Arkion (formerly SkyQraft) in 2019, David Wickström spent over two decades in high-level technical roles within the Swedish tech ecosystem. He served as VP of Engineering and Data Scientist at [24]7.ai and held leadership positions at Campanja and Much Different, where he focused on machine learning and multiplayer network solutions. His extensive earlier career includes architecture and consulting roles for major financial institutions such as SEB, AMF Pension, and Fora AB, as well as a tenure as a Java instructor at IBM Sweden.
education: MSc in Economics, Telecommunications, and Computer Science, KTH Royal Institute of Technology
Entrepreneurship and Practical Business Startup, Stockholm School of Economics

founders.name: Dr. Niall Coogan
founders.bio: Prior to founding AssetCool, Dr. Niall Coogan was a doctoral researcher at the Power Networks Centre for Doctoral Training (CDT) within the University of Manchester. His work focused on the intersection of materials science and electrical engineering, specifically exploring how photonic coatings could address thermal bottlenecks in aging power grids. This academic research directly led to the 2016 spin-out of AssetCool, where he transitioned from a scientist to an entrepreneur to commercialize his discoveries. His background is deeply rooted in deep-tech innovation, bridging the gap between advanced chemistry and real-world infrastructure challenges.
previous_companies: Power Networks Centre for Doctoral Training
education: PhD in Electrical and Electronics Engineering (Power Networks), University of Manchester
Master's in Chemistry, University of Manchester

founders.name: Barry Johnston
founders.bio: Barry Johnston is a greentech engineering innovator who co-founded AssetCool after conducting research at the University of Manchester's EPSRC Power Networks Centre for Doctoral Training. With a career spanning several decades in environmental science and power engineering, he has focused on decarbonization, photonics, and energy network optimization. Prior to founding AssetCool, he worked in academia as a Research Associate and lecturer, specifically at Wrexham University, and provided consultancy for various startup and product development projects.
education: PhD in Power Networks, University of Manchester
MSc in Environmental Biology, University of Liverpool
Postgraduate Certificate in Education (Further Education Science), University of Wolverhampton
BSc Joint Honours, University of Bristol

founders.name: Balaji Sreenivasan
founders.bio: Balaji Sreenivasan began his journey in technology at age eight when he started programming in BASIC on a ZX Spectrum gifted by his father. After completing his engineering studies, he briefly worked as a design engineer at an engineering consulting firm where he identified significant manual inefficiencies. When his proposal to digitize the company's processes was rejected by his manager, he left to launch his own entrepreneurial venture. He founded Aurigo Software Technologies in 2003 to revolutionize the construction inspection industry with scalable, cloud-based software.
education: Bachelor of Engineering in Mechanical Engineering, National Institute of Technology (NIT), Trichy
Master of Science in Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering, University of Florida, Gainesville
Owner/President Management (OPM) Program, Harvard Business School

founders.name: Anirudh Reddy
founders.bio: Anirudh Reddy is an engineer and entrepreneur who was an early team member at Ather Energy, where he helped bring electric two-wheelers from concept to market. Following this, he served as the Director of Strategic Initiatives and Business Head for North America at Zetwerk, a global manufacturing platform, where he played a key role in the company's digital transformation and expansion. He has also co-founded several other ventures, including Grow Your Staff and SuperBaby, before launching Ayr Energy in early 2025 to focus on industrial energy solutions.
education: Dual Degree (B.Tech & M.Tech) in Mechanical Engineering and Energy Technology, Indian Institute of Technology, Madras
High School, The Hyderabad Public School, Begumpet

founders.name: Rahul Arora
founders.bio: Prior to co-founding Ayr Energy, Rahul Arora established a career in global operations and strategic consulting, holding roles at McKinsey & Company and Schlumberger. His experience in these firms focused on the energy and industrial sectors, providing him with a foundation in both technical engineering and commercial strategy. At Ayr Energy, he leverages this background to address bottlenecks in the global power grid supply chain by optimizing the design and delivery of high-voltage equipment.
education: MBA, MIT Sloan School of Management
BTech, Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Madras

founders.name: Yashashvi Takallapalli
founders.bio: Yashashvi Takallapalli is a serial entrepreneur who began his professional career as a consultant at McKinsey & Company. He later transitioned into consumer technology, co-founding the sports news platform SportsCafe and the gaming startup NostraGamus, the latter of which was integrated into the Glance (InMobi Group) unicorn ecosystem. Prior to founding Ayr Energy in 2024, he served as the VP and GM of Gaming at Glance, where he managed large-scale user growth and engagement. His background combines a rigorous technical education from IIT Madras with a business degree from IIM Calcutta.
education: Bachelor's Degree, Indian Institute of Technology, Madras
PGDCM (MBA), Indian Institute of Management, Calcutta

founders.name: Zach Dell
founders.bio: Zach Dell is a serial entrepreneur and former investor whose interest in energy began during college with a project developing anaerobic digestion systems in rural India. Before founding Base Power, he served as an investor at Thrive Capital and worked in private equity at Blackstone, where he focused on energy infrastructure and recognized the massive potential of battery storage. A graduate of the University of Southern California, Dell previously founded several startups, including the fitness platform Sqwatt and the college dating app Thread, before shifting his focus to reinventing the Texas power grid.
education: Bachelor of Arts in Social Sciences (Psychology and Economics), University of Southern California

founders.name: Justin Lopas
founders.bio: Before co-founding Base Power, Justin Lopas built a career as a high-stakes manufacturing leader in the aerospace and defense sectors. He was a pivotal early employee at SpaceX, serving as one of the first four team members to establish the Starbase site in Boca Chica and leading manufacturing for the Starship program. He subsequently served as Head of Manufacturing at Anduril Industries, where he scaled a cross-functional team of over 150 members to develop advanced defense systems. His background is rooted in mechanical engineering, having led the Michigan Baja Racing team while at the University of Michigan.
education: Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering, University of Michigan

founders.name: Angelo Campus
founders.bio: Angelo Campus grew up in rural Nevada City, California, where he was homeschooled and gained early exposure to solar and battery systems while assisting his father, a building contractor. As a QuestBridge scholar at Princeton University, he designed an independent major combining civil engineering and anthropology to focus on renewable energy for rural electrification. During his undergraduate years, he served as the lead designer for a research project in the EPICS (Engineering Projects in Community Service) program that developed the containerized microgrid prototype which launched BoxPower. Since graduating in 2016, he has scaled the company from a university spinoff into a global provider of clean energy solutions, notably returning to his hometown to bootstrap the venture while caring for his aging grandparents.
education: B.S.E. in Civil Engineering and Anthropology (Independent Major), Princeton University

founders.name: Anderson Barkow
founders.bio: Raised in rural Montana, Anderson Barkow's early experience with unreliable power fueled his interest in resilient energy systems. He began his career in corporate finance, spending three years at Bank of America Merrill Lynch's Corporate and Investment Bank underwriting debt for Fortune 500 tech companies. Before co-founding BoxPower, he pivoted to impact-focused ventures, serving as a Social Impact Fellow at RSF Social Finance and a financial consultant for Wakabi Boda Solutions in Uganda.
education: B.S. Finance, Santa Clara University

founders.name: Michele Nesbit
founders.bio: Michele Nesbit is a mechanical engineer and entrepreneur who was born and raised in Grass Valley, California. After graduating with honors from UC Berkeley in 2012, she spent several years in the renewable energy sector, serving as an off-grid system designer and Director of Operations for two regional solar firms. In 2018, she co-founded BoxPower to scale modular solar microgrid solutions, leveraging her technical expertise and a California Class A Engineering Construction License to provide resilient power to rural and disaster-stricken communities.
previous_companies: Director of Operations at two solar companies
education: B.S. in Mechanical Engineering and Material Science & Engineering, UC Berkeley

founders.name: Kaitlyn Albertoli
founders.bio: Before co-founding Buzz Solutions in 2017, Kaitlyn Albertoli worked as a wealth management analyst at J.P. Morgan Chase and led a substantial non-profit operation in the sustainable food sector that managed a team of 60 to serve 300 individuals. She launched Buzz Solutions alongside co-founder Vik Chaudhry while participating in a Stanford University 'Launchpad' course focused on energy and sustainability. A former national-record-holding competitive swimmer, Albertoli's interest in grid resilience was personally motivated by her experience growing up in Southern California, where she witnessed friends and neighbors frequently displaced by devastating wildfires.
education: B.A. in International Relations and Finance, Stanford University

founders.name: Vikhyat Chaudhry
founders.bio: Raised in New Delhi, India, Vikhyat was shaped by his early exposure to frequent grid blackouts and extreme urban air pollution. During his undergraduate studies, he built a custom drone to monitor air quality, which ignited a lifelong passion for leveraging AI and robotics to solve real-world energy infrastructure challenges. Before co-founding Buzz Solutions, he served as the Lead of Machine Learning and AI teams at Cisco Systems and worked as an embedded systems engineer at Altitude. He formalised his expertise at Stanford University, where he specialized in energy engineering and met his co-founder, Kaitlyn Albertoli, while developing drone-based inspection technology for wind turbines.
education: MS in Civil and Environmental Engineering (Energy Engineering & AI), Stanford University
Bachelor of Technology in Civil and Environmental Engineering, Delhi College of Engineering

founders.name: Astrid Atkinson
founders.bio: A native of Australia, Astrid Atkinson originally pursued an academic path in philosophy and cognitive science before moving to the U.S. and joining Google in 2004 as its first technical writer. During her nearly 15-year tenure at the tech giant, she transitioned into engineering leadership as a founding member of the Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team and eventually rose to Senior Director of Software Engineering. She led the development of Google's global web-serving platform and critical infrastructure frameworks before leaving in 2019 to apply her expertise in distributed systems reliability to modernizing the electrical grid.
education: Queensland University of Technology (Philosophy and Cognitive Science)

founders.name: Cody Smith
founders.bio: Cody Smith is a systems engineering expert who spent over 14 years at Google (2004–2018) before co-founding Camus Energy. At Google, he served as a Principal Systems Engineer and the enterprise-wide architect for Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), as well as the production lead for Google Search. Beyond his tenure in big tech, Smith served as the 'Pit Boss' for HealthCare.gov during its critical first open enrollment period, managing technical triage for the federal marketplace. He co-founded Camus Energy in 2019 to apply high-scale distributed systems and zero-trust security principles to the challenge of grid orchestration and decarbonization.
education: BA Mathematics and Computer Science, University of California, Berkeley

founders.name: Michael Ryan
founders.bio: Michael Ryan has over 20 years of experience in software development and executive leadership across the tech and energy sectors. Prior to co-founding Camus Energy, he held strategic roles at GE Power and GE Power Conversion, and served as an operator at major tech firms including NetApp and Sony Biotechnology. His career has focused on data integration, IoT, and grid management, delivering solutions for numerous U.S. utilities and electric cooperatives. He also co-founded Realize 2050, where he continues to provide strategic planning for the transition to distributed energy resources.
education: BS in Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, University of California, Berkeley
MBA, Santa Clara University
Stanford Advanced Project Manager Certification

founders.name: Rafael Narezzi
founders.bio: Before founding Centrii, Rafael Narezzi served as the Group Chief Technology Officer at CFP Energy, where he was instrumental in incubating the technology that became Centrii (originally Cyber Energia). He previously held the role of Chief Information Officer at NextEnergy Capital and Wise Energy, focusing on digital transformation and the integration of machine learning and AI into asset management. With over 20 years of experience in cybersecurity, particularly within the financial and energy sectors, he has also served as the CTO of TS Lombard and a senior advisor for multi-national defense organizations. His career is characterized by a transition from high-level corporate technology leadership to specialized entrepreneurship in operational technology (OT) security.
education: Master's Degree in Forensic Computing, Cybersecurity, and Counter-terrorism, Northumbria University

founders.name: Jonathan Navon
founders.bio: Founder of CENTRII.

founders.name: Amir Zilberstein
founders.bio: Before co-founding Claroty, Amir Zilberstein was a seasoned serial entrepreneur who established several high-impact cybersecurity firms. He previously co-founded Waterfall Security Solutions, specializing in security gateways for critical infrastructure, and Gita Technologies, a cyber and intelligence R&D firm that was later acquired by Verint Systems. Earlier in his career, he served as a commander and manager of a high-level research and development team within an elite cyber unit of the Israel Defense Forces. With over 25 years of experience in the field, he holds more than 10 patents related to cybersecurity products and currently serves as a Managing Partner at the cybersecurity foundry Team8.
education: B.S. in Computer Science and Mathematics, Bar-Ilan University
M.S. in Computer Science, Bar-Ilan University

founders.name: Benny Porat
founders.role: Co-Founder and former CTO of Claroty; Co-Founder and CEO of Twine Security
founders.bio: Before co-founding Claroty, Benny Porat served as a research team leader in the Israel Defense Forces' elite Unit 8200, where he earned the prestigious Israel Defense Award for his strategic contributions. He later worked as a security researcher at NorthBit, applying his deep technical expertise to vulnerability research. An engineer from a young age, Porat developed his problem-solving mindset by repairing gadgets with his family, a trait that eventually led him to pursue advanced academic research in algorithms and pattern matching. Following a decade-long tenure at Claroty, he launched Twine Security in 2024 to focus on AI-driven cybersecurity solutions.
education: PhD in Computer Science, Bar-Ilan University
MSc in Algorithms, Bar-Ilan University
BSc in Computer Science, Bar-Ilan University

founders.name: Galina Antova
founders.bio: Galina Antova began her career at IBM in Canada, where she spent six years in software development and technical integration of cloud acquisitions. After earning an MBA from IMD in Switzerland, she was recruited into Siemens’ elite leadership program and went on to establish the company's first Industrial Cybersecurity business unit as its Global Head. Spurred by the security gaps she observed in critical infrastructure during the Stuxnet era, she left her executive role to co-found Claroty in 2015. She is now recognized as a leading expert in protecting cyber-physical systems and a vocal advocate for diversity in the technology sector.
education: BS in Computer Science, York University
MBA, IMD Business School

founders.name: Tom Hoff
founders.bio: Before founding Clean Power Research in 1998, Tom Hoff spent over a decade in R&D at Pacific Gas and Electric (PG&E), where he focused on the economic valuation of solar energy. His move to entrepreneurship was motivated by a neighbor's question regarding the personal value of solar, prompting him to develop the industry's first online PV calculation tools. While consulting for utilities and national labs, he pursued a PhD at Stanford University, effectively turning his academic research into the commercial algorithms that underpin the science of valuing distributed generation.
education: BS, Mathematics and Computer Science, California Lutheran University
MS, Engineering, Washington University in St. Louis
MDiv, Trinity Evangelical Divinity School
PhD, Engineering-Economic Systems, Stanford University

founders.name: Ben Peters
founders.bio: Prior to co-founding Cogna in 2023, Ben Peters was a co-founder and VP of Product at Five (formerly FiveAI), a self-driving car startup that raised nearly $77 million before its acquisition by Bosch in 2022. He previously served as the VP of Product and Marketing at Neul, an IoT connectivity startup that was acquired by Huawei in 2015. His career also includes product management at NXP Semiconductors and early engineering roles at RF Solutions. With over 20 years of experience, Peters has successfully navigated two major startup exits and numerous high-profile venture capital rounds.
education: MBA, University of Warwick
BEng, Electronic Engineering, University of Brighton
Alcester Grammar School

founders.name: Lars Mennen
founders.bio: Prior to co-founding Cogna, Lars was a key technical leader in the autonomous driving and generative AI sectors. He was the inaugural hire at Five (formerly FiveAI), where he spent nearly seven years architecting the initial self-driving stack and technical processes leading up to the company's acquisition by Bosch in 2022. Following the acquisition, he joined the Bay Area-based startup Cresta as an early hire, eventually running all AI-related efforts including production infrastructure, NLP modeling, and the fine-tuning of large language models.
education: Masters in Mathematics, University of Cambridge

founders.name: Whitman Fulton
founders.bio: Before founding ConnectDER, Whitman Fulton spent over two decades at the intersection of energy policy and hardware innovation, filing his first patent for a meter-based interconnection device in 1998. He previously worked as an independent energy researcher and consultant, co-authoring influential technical papers on global electricity sector transitions and energy scenarios, including studies on China's power grid. In 2011, he launched Infinite Invention (later rebranded as ConnectDER) in Arlington, Virginia, to commercialize his 'Solar Socket' invention, which has since become a standard for simplifying residential solar and EV installations. His background combines high-level international policy training with hands-on electrical engineering, positioning him as a leading technical voice in the distributed energy resource (DER) space.
education: University of Mississippi (B.A.)
Johns Hopkins University School of Advanced International Studies (M.A. in International Relations and Economics)

founders.name: Grzegorz Marecki
founders.bio: Grzegorz Marecki began his career as a civil engineer at AECOM, where he managed large-scale infrastructure projects across the United States, Europe, and Asia. In 2016, he transitioned into a leadership role as the Head of Research for HYPED, the University of Edinburgh's hyperloop team, where he spearheaded the development of high-speed transport modeling. This work served as the catalyst for co-founding Continuum Industries in 2018, leveraging AI-powered spatial planning to accelerate the global transition to renewable energy and sustainable infrastructure.
education: Master of Engineering (MEng), Heriot-Watt University

founders.name: Emil Hansen
founders.bio: Before co-founding Continuum Industries, Emil Hansen served as the Technical Director for HYPED, the University of Edinburgh's Hyperloop society. In this role, he led an engineering team of over 100 members to design and build two functional Hyperloop pod prototypes, including a model that competed at the 2018 SpaceX Pod Competition in Silicon Valley. This high-stakes engineering experience provided the technical foundation for Optioneer, Continuum’s AI-powered infrastructure platform. Hansen transitioned directly from his university studies into entrepreneurship, launching the company in June 2018.
education: University of Edinburgh

founders.name: Adam Anyszewski
founders.bio: Adam Anyszewski's career began at the University of Edinburgh, where he served as President of HYPED, the university's award-winning Hyperloop team. During this time, he led a multidisciplinary group of students to design and prototype high-speed transit pods for SpaceX’s global competitions. Recognizing that the primary obstacle to revolutionary infrastructure was the slow, manual planning process rather than the technology itself, he co-founded Continuum Industries in 2018. His work now focuses on using AI-powered 'optioneering' to accelerate the design and delivery of critical energy and water infrastructure.
education: PhD in Infrastructure Engineering Management, University of Edinburgh (2022)
MEng in Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, University of Edinburgh (2017)

founders.name: Matt Blythe
founders.bio: Before co-founding Continuum Industries, Matt Blythe built a career in infrastructure advisory and climate policy, working with organizations such as Adam Smith International and the Green Alliance. He specialized in sourcing and leading investments in early-stage climate solutions and industrial decarbonization, later applying this expertise to the development of AI-driven infrastructure planning tools. During his time at the University of Cambridge, he served as the Sport Editor for the student newspaper, Varsity, showcasing an early interest in communications alongside his technical studies. His research into evolutionary algorithms for infrastructure design has been featured at major machine learning conferences like ICML.
education: BA in Economics, University of Cambridge
MSc in Finance, University of Edinburgh Business School

founders.name: Hugues de Bantel
founders.bio: Before co-founding Cosmo Tech in 2010, Hugues de Bantel served as the CEO and a Director of EDAP TMS, a NASDAQ-listed medical technology company headquartered in Lyon. His extensive international background includes managing technology firms across Asia, Europe, and the U.S., specifically holding leadership roles in Malaysia and Tokyo. He also founded and managed Alticare, a boutique consulting firm that assisted high-tech startups with global development and scaling strategies.
education: MBA, IMD Lausanne
Master's in Business Management, NEOMA Business School

founders.name: Michel Morvan
founders.bio: Michel Morvan transition from a distinguished career in academia to industrial leadership, serving as a Full Professor of Computer Science at ENS Lyon and a Chair at EHESS before becoming Chief Scientist and Corporate Vice President at Veolia Environnement. In 2010, he leveraged his expertise in complex systems modeling to co-found Cosmo Tech, aiming to revolutionize enterprise decision-making through simulation digital twins. Beyond his corporate role, he is a serial entrepreneur and the current President of the IRT SystemX, where he fosters digital transformation in French industry.
education: PhD in Computer Science, University of Montpellier
Executive Education, Harvard Business School
Executive Education, The Wharton School

founders.name: C. Kerry Nemovicher
founders.bio: Dr. C. Kerry Nemovicher is a veteran technologist whose career began as an infantryman in the Israel Defense Forces, where he served during the War of Attrition and the Yom Kippur War. After his military service, he held early technical roles at Israel Aircraft Industries before completing a Ph.D. at Lehigh University with a focus on automated database design. He later joined the research ranks at Bell Labs and transitioned to NYNEX Corporation, where he led pioneering taskforces in artificial intelligence and personal computing. He co-founded Crytica Security to bring to market his invention, the Rapid Detection & Alert (RDA) system.
education: BA, St. John's College
MS, Industrial Engineering, Lehigh University
PhD, Lehigh University

founders.name: C. Lloyd Mahaffey
founders.bio: C. Lloyd Mahaffey began his career as a sales engineer at Honeywell and PCA International before joining Apple during its formative years. At Apple, he became the Director of the Apple Education Group and General Manager of the Federal Systems Group, where he transformed the education division into a billion-dollar business unit. He later served as the Chief Operating Officer of VeriFone, leading the team through its $1.3 billion acquisition by Hewlett Packard. A veteran of the Silicon Valley venture capital scene, Mahaffey has been involved with nearly 40 early-stage companies and has completed over $1.5 billion in private equity and public market transactions.
education: B.A. in History, The Citadel (The Military College of South Carolina)
Technology Executive Program, Stanford University Graduate School of Business

founders.name: John Bertrand
founders.bio: John Bertrand is a licensed Professional Engineer with over 15 years of experience in the water and wastewater industry prior to founding Daupler in 2017. He served as a collections system engineer at a major U.S. treatment plant and worked as a consultant for international engineering firms HDR and Black & Veatch. His firsthand experience with the inefficiencies of traditional utility response processes led him to develop a platform designed to automate and streamline emergency triage and dispatch for public works. Bertrand is also a Techstars mentor and an advisor for Sandalphon Capital, deeply rooted in the Kansas City startup ecosystem.
education: BS in Civil Engineering, University of Kansas

founders.name: Ryan Rosenbaum
founders.bio: Ryan Rosenbaum is a software engineer and the technical co-founder of Daupler, which he launched in 2017 alongside John Bertrand. Before founding the company, Rosenbaum was deeply involved in the Kansas City startup ecosystem while attending the University of Missouri-Kansas City (UMKC), where he was recognized as a Student Entrepreneur of the Year. He partnered with Bertrand, a former public works professional, to build an AI-driven platform that automates emergency response and communication for utilities and local governments. Rosenbaum's technical leadership guided the startup through the Techstars Kansas City accelerator in 2018 and has since powered its expansion across North America.
education: University of Missouri-Kansas City (UMKC)

founders.name: Naresh Soni
founders.bio: Naresh Soni is a technology veteran who began his career at IBM specializing in robotics, automation, and data engineering, where he contributed to the development of the PowerPC architecture. He later joined AT&T Bell Labs, where he was instrumental in creating innovative mobile architectures, including early GSM phone and 'phablet' designs. Before founding DeepMatrix in 2022, he held executive and technical leadership positions at global firms like Nokia, STMicroelectronics, and InterDigital, and served as the CTO of the AI-first platform CXApp.
education: Master's in Computer Engineering, University of Texas, Austin

founders.name: Kaustubh Tripathi
founders.bio: Kaustubh Tripathi is a technical leader in the geospatial deep-tech sector, currently serving as the Co-Founder and CTO of DeepMatrix. Before launching the company in early 2022, he developed a specialized expertise in GIS (Geographic Information Systems) and remote sensing, focusing on the ingestion and analysis of large-scale environmental and industrial datasets. His work is primarily centered on building cloud-native SaaS platforms like 'FLY' to optimize resource management in the mining and urban development sectors. He has recently led significant AI-driven pilots for rural drainage infrastructure in collaboration with Indian government initiatives such as the SVAMITVA scheme.
education: Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech), Indian Institute of Technology (ISM) Dhanbad

founders.name: Sam Zheng
founders.bio: Prior to founding DeepHow, Sam Zheng spent over a decade at Siemens as a senior research scientist and eventually as the Head of User Experience for digital innovation. During his tenure at Siemens, he led pioneering projects like the Cloud Digital Inspection Jacket, which earned his team the prestigious Siemens Innovation Award. A specialist in engineering psychology and human-centered AI, Zheng transitioned from corporate research to entrepreneurship in 2018 by launching DeepHow through the Techstars Mobility Accelerator in Detroit. He continues to bridge academia and industry as an adjunct professor of psychology at Tsinghua University.
education: PhD in Engineering Psychology, University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign
Master's in Statistics, University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign

founders.name: Patrik Matos
founders.bio: Before co-founding DeepHow, Patrik Matos spent nearly a decade as an innovation leader at Siemens, primarily within Siemens Healthineers and Corporate Technology. During his tenure, he developed award-winning digital solutions, including a notable eye-typing interface for Professor Stephen Hawking and various industrial knowledge-sharing platforms. His work focused on human-centered AI and interaction design, eventually leading him to pilot an early version of the DeepHow platform across 30 Siemens service centers worldwide. In 2018, he transitioned into the startup ecosystem by participating in the Techstars Mobility Accelerator in Detroit.
education: B.S. in Design, ESDI - Escola Superior de Desenho Industrial
Degree in Interaction Design, Hochschule für Gestaltung Schwäbisch Gmünd

founders.name: Wei-Liang Kao
founders.bio: Prior to co-founding DeepHow, Wei-Liang Kao was an innovation leader and research scientist at Siemens Corporate Technology and Siemens Healthineers, where he specialized in digital innovation for the industrial and manufacturing sectors. During his tenure at Siemens, he was part of the pioneering team that developed an assistive eye-typing solution for Professor Stephen Hawking to aid individuals with ALS. His academic background is rooted in human-computer interaction and wearable technology; notably, his doctoral research at Purdue University involved creating biomedical sensing systems for students with learning disabilities, which earned him the Grand Prize in the IBM Big Data for Social Good Challenge. In 2018, he transitioned from corporate R&D to the startup world, launching DeepHow through the Techstars Mobility Accelerator in Detroit.
education: PhD, Computer Information and Technology, Purdue University

founders.name: Gilberto DeSalvo
founders.bio: Before founding Delphire, Gilberto DeSalvo was a doctoral researcher at Caltech, where he specialized in machine learning and biological data automation. His path to entrepreneurship was triggered by a personal tragedy when his apartment caught fire due to an electrical fault in the unit below, an experience that left him displaced and inspired him to repurpose his AI expertise for early wildfire detection. Prior to his PhD, he developed a strong technical foundation in genomics and lab automation while conducting research at UC Santa Barbara.
education: PhD in Biology, California Institute of Technology (2018)
BS in Biology, University of California, Santa Barbara (2007)

founders.name: Robert M. Lee
founders.bio: Robert M. Lee is a pioneer in industrial cybersecurity who began his career as a U.S. Air Force Cyber Warfare Operations Officer. Tasked to the National Security Agency (NSA), he established a first-of-its-kind mission to identify and analyze national-level threats to industrial control systems (ICS). After leading the investigation into the 2015 cyberattack on Ukraine’s power grid, he co-founded Dragos in 2016 alongside Jon Lavender and Justin Cavinee to provide specialized defense for critical infrastructure. He is also a prominent educator, serving as a SANS Institute Fellow and authoring foundational courses on ICS active defense and threat intelligence.
education: Bachelor of Science (B.S.) in Social Sciences, United States Air Force Academy (USAFA)
Master of Science (M.S.) in Cybersecurity - Computer Forensics, Utica University

founders.name: Jon Lavender
founders.bio: Before founding Dragos, Jon Lavender served in the National Security Agency (NSA), where he led red and blue team operations and established a mission for identifying nation-state threats against critical infrastructure. He met his co-founders, Robert M. Lee and Justin Cavinee, while working in the U.S. Intelligence Community in Germany, where they first collaborated on the ICS assessment tool CyberLens. Lavender also gained private sector experience at the Corporate Executive Board (CEB) and is a heart transplant survivor whose personal journey has been profiled by his alma mater.
education: BS in Management Information Systems, Wake Forest University
MS in Cyber Security, University of North Carolina at Charlotte

founders.name: Justin Cavinee
founders.bio: Before co-founding Dragos, Justin Cavinee was a key member of the U.S. Intelligence Community, where he developed advanced analytics to identify and track sophisticated threats against industrial control systems (ICS). He met his fellow co-founders while stationed in Germany, where they collaborated on early detection technologies like CyberLens. His pre-founding career involves performing high-stakes intrusion analysis and incident response against national-level adversaries across critical sectors such as power, nuclear, and manufacturing. Cavinee's background as a practitioner in red and blue team operations informs his current leadership in content development and behavioral analytics at Dragos.
education: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Ohio University
Master of Science in Computer Science, Johns Hopkins University

founders.name: Byron Rojas
founders.bio: Before founding Easymetering, Byron Rojas spent over a decade as a pioneer in cellular data transmission and advanced metering technology. He began his career at BISMARK SA, rising to Business Development Manager where he integrated early cellular network products in alliance with Ericsson. In 1999, he founded BARRICK S.A., where he developed innovative CDPD routers for international banking and lottery networks. By 2003, he transitioned into the energy sector, developing early Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) modules for companies like ABB and Elster Solutions before eventually launching Easymetering in 2010.
education: Electronic Engineering (Specialty in Telecommunications), Escuela Superior Politécnica del Litoral (ESPOL), 1996

founders.name: Juan Javier Cajas
founders.bio: Juan Javier Cajas is a Professional Engineer (PE) with over 20 years of experience in multidisciplinary engineering and design coordination. Before co-founding Easymetering in 2012, he established himself as a Mechanical Engineer specializing in streamlining design processes, including a significant tenure at TLC Engineering for Architecture. His career has focused on transitioning traditional mechanical and industrial engineering practices into the development of advanced wireless AMI (Advanced Metering Infrastructure) technologies for the global utility market.
education: M.S. in Industrial Engineering, Purdue University

founders.name: Matthew Harding
founders.bio: Matthew Harding is an econometrician and data scientist who held faculty positions at Stanford and Duke before becoming a Professor of Economics and Statistics at UC Irvine. At Duke, he established the Energy Data Analytics Lab and served as the Founding Director of the Duke-UNC USDA Center for Behavioral Economics. He has extensive experience applying machine learning to large-scale consumer databases, having consulted for major organizations including Apple Inc., the World Bank, and the Department of Justice. In 2017, he founded EcoMetricx to bridge the gap between academic economic theory and industry-scale AI solutions for customer engagement and energy optimization.
education: PhD in Economics, Massachusetts Institute of Technology
M.Phil. in Economics, University of Oxford
B.A. in Economics and Philosophy, University College London

founders.name: Ebrahim Balouji
founders.bio: Dr. Ebrahim Balouji is the CEO and founder of EcoPhi (formerly Eneryield), a deep-tech startup that emerged from his extensive research at Chalmers University of Technology. Before transitioning into the startup world in 2019, he spent over a decade in academic and research roles, including serving as a Research Assistant at Gazi University and a Ph.D. researcher at Chalmers. His technical expertise lies in integrating AI and signal processing into power systems to create proactive, sensor-less fault prediction tools for the energy grid. A dual PhD recipient, Balouji has dedicated his career to digitalizing the power system to enhance energy efficiency and facilitate the integration of renewable energy sources.
education: Ph.D. in Signal and Systems from Chalmers University of Technology
Ph.D. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering from Gazi University
M.Eng. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering from Gazi University
B.A.Sc. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering from Gazi University

founders.name: Joel Santisteban
founders.bio: Before founding Ecosuite, Joel Santisteban spent six years at Ecogy Energy, where he served as Director of Platform and Development Manager, overseeing the creation of digital systems for distributed energy resources. His early professional career includes three years as a financial analyst on the ETF trading desk at Morgan Stanley and engineering internships at Northrop Grumman. He is a serial entrepreneur who previously co-founded Sun&Energy and is a former collegiate athlete, having played football while studying at MIT.
education: Bachelor of Science in Aerospace Engineering, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT)

founders.name: Philip Court
founders.bio: Philip Court is a technologist and entrepreneur who spent the early part of his career in New Zealand leading software engineering and management for green technology ventures. Before co-founding Ecosuite, he was a Director at Greenstage and Greenstage Power, where he spearheaded the development of electric vehicle technology and open-source renewable energy data platforms like SolarNetwork. He later moved to Brooklyn to join Ecogy Energy as a strategist, focusing on scaling distributed energy resource (DER) solutions. His background combines high-performance engineering, such as building electric racing cars, with deep expertise in AI-driven solar asset management.
education: Bachelor of Computing and Mathematical Sciences (B.C.M.S.) in Applied Mathematics (Hons), University of Waikato

founders.name: Richard McIndoe
