founders.bio: James Huang is a materials science expert and co-founder of TS Conductor, where he serves as the primary architect of the company’s patented conductor technology. Before co-founding the startup in 2018 with his brother Jason Huang and sister-in-law Rulong Chen, he served as the Chief Technology Officer (CTO) at CTC Global, a major manufacturer of advanced conductors. His specialized experience in carbon composite materials led to the development of the unique encapsulated core design that allows TS Conductor products to be installed using standard utility tools while doubling capacity and halving energy loss.
education: Materials Science and Engineering (Field of Study)

founders.name: Rulong Chen
founders.bio: Rulong Chen is a veteran of the renewable energy industry who spent over a decade as the Director of the Solar Cell R&D Department at Wuxi Suntech Power, once the world's largest solar panel manufacturer. During her tenure, she led the development of advanced high-efficiency technologies such as the 'Pluto' cell series and managed significant technical collaborations with the University of New South Wales (UNSW) in Australia. In 2018, she leveraged her expertise in materials science and industrial manufacturing to co-found TS Conductor, focusing on modernizing the power grid with high-capacity, low-loss conductor technology.
education: University of New South Wales (Photovoltaics Research)
Jiangnan University

founders.name: Lowell Kraff
founders.bio: Before co-founding Ubicquia in 2014, Lowell Kraff spent over 25 years as a prominent private equity and venture capital investor specializing in leveraged buyouts and growth equity. He co-founded the independent sponsor firm Trivergance and served as a co-founding partner and Vice Chairman of Diamond Resorts International. Earlier in his career, he founded merchant banking firms such as Connecting Capital & Partners and Vision Capital Partners, where he was involved in over $3.6 billion in transaction value. His pre-Ubicquia experience focused on identifying industry trends and structuring complex financial transactions across diverse sectors including real estate and finance.
education: B.S. in Economics from The Wharton School, University of Pennsylvania
MBA from the University of Chicago Booth School of Business

founders.name: Tre Zimmerman
founders.role: Co-Founder and former CTO of Ubicquia
founders.bio: Tre Zimmerman is a prolific serial entrepreneur who began his career in the late 1990s by pioneering online music distribution before transitioning into smart city infrastructure. Before co-founding Ubicquia in 2014, he spent over two decades in high-level product development and corporate roles at global technology firms including Nero, Xaitel Communications, and TvBlob Ltd. A self-taught technologist, he holds more than 23 U.S. patents across emerging sectors such as small cell development, IoT, and energy grid monitoring. His early professional journey was shaped by a series of childhood ventures ranging from selling baseball cards to producing surf and skate videos for his local community.
education: Florida Southern College (Awarded Catalyst Award, Class of 2004)

founders.name: Marc Byron
founders.bio: Marc Byron was a prolific serial entrepreneur with over 30 years of experience in performance marketing and customer acquisition before co-founding Ubicquia in 2014. In 1997, he founded Paradigm Direct, a pioneering pay-for-performance marketing firm sold to The Mosaic Group for $241 million, and later founded TRANZACT in 2003, which grew into a leading direct-to-consumer platform. He also served as the Co-Founder and CEO of the private equity firm Trivergance, where he leveraged his expertise in business-building and lead generation to scale multiple Fortune 500 joint ventures.
education: B.A. in Economics, Emory University (1985)

founders.name: Hanno Blankenstein
founders.bio: Before founding Unleash Live in 2016, Hanno Blankenstein was a Partner and Managing Director at BCG Digital Ventures, where he built businesses in robotics and autonomous vehicles. He is a serial entrepreneur who co-founded the strategic design firm S&C, which was acquired by BCG in 2014, as well as the location-based services startup Pocketweb. Hanno’s career began with a passion for aviation and coding, leading him to develop flight simulation software for BitGLOBE and hold leadership roles at Vodafone and Booz & Company.
education: MBA, Duke University - The Fuqua School of Business
Business Degree, The Julius Maximilians University of Würzburg
Marketing and Finance, University of California, Berkeley

founders.name: Jason Grier
founders.bio: Before founding Unleash Live in 2016, Jason Grier developed a background in business development and customer success with a focus on organizational design and growth. He is a passionate innovator and sports coach who transitioned his expertise in human performance and team dynamics into the tech sector. He is also the founder of Superbly, a platform dedicated to fostering positive workplace culture through behavioral recognition.
education: University of Sydney (Startup Community Member)

founders.name: Adrian Tuck
founders.role: CEO of Uptempo (Former Founder & CEO of Uplight)
founders.bio: Before founding Uplight, Adrian Tuck spent seven years as a highly decorated officer in the British Army, including service in Operation Desert Storm. Following his military career, he entered the technology sector, holding executive roles at Soft-ex and Ember Corporation, where he was instrumental in establishing the wireless sensor network industry. Driven by a mission to address climate change after reading Al Gore’s 'An Inconvenient Truth,' he pivoted to energy analytics, leading Tendril for over a decade before merging it with other firms to form the clean-energy unicorn Uplight.
education: Royal Military Academy Sandhurst (Officer Training)

founders.name: Yoav Lurie
founders.role: Founder and former President & COO of Uplight
founders.bio: Prior to co-founding Uplight through the merger of Simple Energy and Tendril, Yoav Lurie helped build Synteractive, a Washington D.C.-based IT services firm, where he led the technical effort to rebuild the federal website Recovery.gov. He also served as a Managing Director for Teach For America and was a key contributor to Crisis Commons, building crowd-sourced disaster relief applications. Lurie's entrepreneurial journey began as an undergraduate at Duke University, where he launched the first chapter of Camp Kesem, a national network of camps for children of cancer patients.
education: BA in Public Policy Studies, Duke University

founders.name: Justin Segall
founders.bio: Before co-founding Uplight through a major 2019 merger, Justin Segall was the President and co-founder of Simple Energy, a utility customer engagement platform that graduated from Techstars Boulder in 2011. His career began with senior roles at the $3 billion Atlanta BeltLine urban redevelopment project followed by a tenure as VP of Resource Development at Renewable Choice Energy, where he led trading and origination in carbon markets. A dedicated sustainability advocate, he is credited with leading Simple Energy to become a certified B Corporation and subsequently scaling Uplight into a clean-tech unicorn.
education: Duke University (Cum Laude)

founders.name: Swapnil Shah
founders.bio: Swapnil Shah is a prolific serial entrepreneur who founded and led four enterprise software companies to successful exits prior to the formation of Uplight. His career began with co-founding Open Environment Corp, which went public in 1995, followed by the founding of WebSpective (acquired by Inktomi) and mValent (acquired by Oracle). Before launching his clean energy venture FirstFuel Software—which later merged with Tendril to become Uplight—Shah served as a Vice President and General Manager at Inktomi and was a Venture Partner at Charles River Ventures. He is currently a Partner at Energy Impact Partners, where he focuses on scaling climate-tech ventures and advancing the global energy transition.
education: BS, Mechanical & Aerospace Engineering, Cornell University

founders.name: Aaron Goldfeder
founders.role: Founder and CEO of AZX; Co-founder of Uplight (via EnergySavvy)
founders.bio: Aaron Goldfeder is a seasoned technology entrepreneur and climate leader who began his career at Microsoft, spending over six years as a Principal Group Program Manager leading key initiatives for Windows XP and Internet Explorer. In 2008, he co-founded EnergySavvy, a pioneering utility analytics platform that was acquired in 2019 to help form Uplight, where he continued to drive large-scale decarbonization efforts. A serial founder, he also co-founded the AI2 Incubator-backed startup Meetingflow (acquired by Augment) before launching AZX in 2024 to focus on custom AI business transformations.
education: B.S. in Mathematics, University of Michigan

founders.name: Bruce Townson
founders.role: Founder and former CEO of Ecotagious (acquired by Uplight)
founders.bio: Bruce Townson has over 20 years of experience in strategy and business development within the clean energy and technology sectors. Prior to founding Ecotagious in 2012, he served as a consultant for the Boston Consulting Group (BCG) and worked as a District Engineer for Schlumberger in the energy sector. His career has focused on leveraging data analytics and machine learning to drive energy conservation and utility customer engagement.
education: Bachelor of Science (Engineering and Physics), Queen's University
Master of Business Administration (MBA), Columbia University

founders.name: Corey Capasso
founders.bio: Before founding Urbint in 2015, Corey Capasso established himself as a prolific serial entrepreneur and inventor, launching and exiting multiple technology ventures. While still a student at the University of Wisconsin, he founded ECHS, a network of college-oriented websites, and later developed Polyflav, a proprietary technology for infusing flavor into plastics. Capasso is perhaps best known for founding Spinback, a social commerce platform acquired by Buddy Media (and later Salesforce), and Nomi Technologies, an enterprise retail analytics company acquired by Brickstream in 2014.
education: BBA in Risk Management Insurance and Entrepreneurship, University of Wisconsin-Madison

founders.name: Ryan Schmukler
founders.bio: Ryan Schmukler is a prolific technologist and entrepreneur who built a reputation in the Madison, Wisconsin, startup scene before co-founding Urbint. Prior to Urbint, he served as the lead developer for the social competition platform WomStreet and founded Teknql, a software consulting collective and agency. Despite holding a business degree, Schmukler identifies primarily as a computer scientist and is a prominent figure in the open-source community, having created or maintained over 50 libraries including the original Angular Material UI library and the Node.js job scheduler Agenda.
education: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Information Systems and Entrepreneurship, University of Wisconsin-Madison
Minor in Computer Science, University of Wisconsin-Madison

founders.name: Josh Troy
founders.bio: Prior to co-founding Urbint, Josh Troy built an extensive career in finance and operations leadership within the technology and real estate sectors. He served as the Head of Finance at StreetEasy, where he played a pivotal role in the company's $50 million acquisition by Zillow, and later held management positions at CompStak and Spotad. Troy began his professional career at KPMG as a Senior Associate in the advisory services practice, focusing on internal operations and process improvements for global clients. He is a licensed CPA with a deep focus on the intersection of data aggregation and enterprise software.
education: BBA in Accounting and Finance, University of Texas at Austin (McCombs School of Business)
Prague University of Economics and Business

founders.name: Scott DePasquale
founders.bio: Before founding Utilidata, Scott DePasquale spent nearly two decades in the energy and financial sectors, beginning his career as a commodities trader and infrastructure investor. He served as a partner at the venture capital firm Braemar Energy Ventures and as a Senior Vice President at GE Financial Services, where he led energy-technology investment activities. DePasquale also gained significant policy experience as a regulator for the Massachusetts Department of Telecommunications and Energy and managed analytics for an energy security think tank. In 2012, he orchestrated the acquisition and relocation of Utilidata's predecessor company to establish it as a commercial leader in grid automation.
previous_companies: Massachusetts Department of Telecommunications and Energy
Analysis and Resilience Center for Systemic Risk (ARC)
education: Bachelor of Science in Business Administration, Bryant University
Master of Science in Finance, Suffolk University
Master of Arts in International Relations and Affairs, Tufts University

founders.name: Francis Rumenos Piedade
founders.bio: Francis Rumenos Piedade is a pioneer in the Brazilian industrial automation and microcomputing sectors, co-founding Engetécnica in 1976 (which later evolved into Varix and Varixx). Before the company's expansion into microcomputers, he focused on developing specialized electro-electronic control systems for the Brazilian sugar and alcohol industry. In 1983, he led the engineering of the Varix VC50, a professional 8-bit computer that improved upon standard Motorola hardware designs. His technical career has been defined by a deep focus on automation, control, and thermography systems, for which he holds several patents.
education: Electronic Engineering Degree (Engenheiro Eletrônico)

founders.name: Álvaro Piedade
founders.bio: Álvaro Piedade co-founded the Brazilian technology firm Engetécnica (now known as Varixx) in 1976 alongside partners Francis Rumenos Piedade and João Eugênio Piedade Neto. Originally trained as a civil engineer, he helped steer the company from its early focus on electro-electronic control systems for sugar and ethanol mills into the emerging microcomputer market of the 1980s. Under his leadership, the company developed the Varix VC50, an 8-bit professional computer, before eventually pivoting back to its core strengths in industrial automation and power electronics.
education: Civil Engineering Degree (Engenheiro Civil)

founders.name: João Eugênio Piedade Neto
founders.bio: Before evolving Varixx into a leading power electronics firm, João Eugênio Piedade Neto co-founded Engetécnica Engenharia Comércio e Indústria Ltda. in 1976 alongside Francis Rumenos Piedade and Álvaro Piedade. Originally trained in civil engineering, he helped lead the company's early foray into the Brazilian microcomputer market with the development of the Varix VC 50 in the 1980s. Over the last four decades, he has transitioned the company toward high-voltage industrial automation and power systems while managing a portfolio of commercial and industrial enterprises in Piracicaba.
previous_companies: Engetécnica Engenharia Comércio e Indústria Ltda.
education: Degree in Civil Engineering

founders.name: Jon M. Williams
founders.bio: Jon M. Williams is a serial entrepreneur who spent the first three decades of his career in environmental remediation and brownfield redevelopment as the founder of Ontario Specialty Contracting (OSC). His professional mission was deeply influenced by witnessing the industrial decay of his hometown, leading him to specialize in repurposing abandoned industrial sites for the green economy. After successfully launching Green Machine to develop battery-powered construction equipment, he founded Viridi Parente to scale fail-safe lithium-ion battery storage solutions for industrial, medical, and residential applications.
education: Bachelor of Science in Business and Economics, St. John Fisher College (1984)

founders.name: Kapil Singhal
founders.bio: Kapil began his career as a field engineer at Ericsson, where he worked on the ground building some of India's first mobile networks. He later moved to the UK and held senior leadership roles at Aricent Group, where he scaled the European business to £250 million in revenue prior to its acquisition by KKR. Drawing on his technical background and firsthand experience with field inefficiencies, he co-founded Vyntelligence in 2013 to revolutionize field work through video AI and digital work intelligence.
education: Bachelor of Technology in Electrical Engineering & Computer Science, Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Delhi
Executive MBA, London Business School

founders.name: Arti Khanna
founders.bio: Arti Khanna is a veteran technology leader with over 25 years of experience across software engineering, product management, and business development. Before co-founding Vyntelligence, she spent over a decade in senior technical and strategic roles at the Aricent Group (now part of Capgemini), Flextronics Software Systems, and Hughes Software Systems. A Gold Medallist in Computer Science, she transitioned from a deep background in solution architecture and technical leadership to entrepreneurship, initially founding humanLearning (hL) to redefine professional development through AI and video intelligence.
education: B.E. in Computer Science (Gold Medallist), Delhi College of Engineering

founders.name: Apoorv Bhargava
founders.bio: Before founding WeaveGrid, Apoorv Bhargava spent over a decade at the intersection of energy, technology, and finance, including roles in business strategy at Opower and management consulting at The Boston Consulting Group's energy practice. His commitment to climate innovation was sparked by a childhood experience with severe water rationing on the island of Cyprus, which motivated him to investigate the relationships between natural resources and energy systems. Prior to starting WeaveGrid, he also gained critical experience at NRG Energy, Joby Aviation, and as a cleantech investor with The Capricorn Investment Group.
education: MBA, Stanford Graduate School of Business
MS in Environment & Resources, Stanford University
BS in Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering, Rice University
BA in Economics, Rice University

founders.name: John Taggart
founders.bio: John Taggart has spent over 15 years at the intersection of electric vehicles and utility systems, beginning his career at the Science & Technology Policy Institute supporting the White House's Office of Science and Technology Policy. He later worked in the Office of the CTO and Special Projects at Tesla, where he focused on lifecycle emissions analysis, and conducted research at Nissan’s Futures Lab. Taggart co-founded WeaveGrid in 2018 after meeting his co-founder at Stanford while completing a doctorate focused on the grid and emissions impacts of electric vehicles.
education: PhD in Management Science and Engineering, Stanford University
MS in Civil and Environmental Engineering, Stanford University
Bachelor's degree in Public & International Affairs, Princeton University

founders.name: John Dean
founders.bio: John Dean is the CEO and co-founder of WindBorne Systems, a company he launched in 2019 after dropping out of his master’s program in electrical engineering at Stanford University. Before founding WindBorne, he gained significant technical experience as a hardware development intern at SpaceX, where he worked on Falcon 9 main engine controls, and as an autonomous driving intern at Lyft. During his time at Stanford, Dean served as co-president of the Stanford Space Initiative (SSI), the student-led organization where the record-breaking balloon technology that became WindBorne's foundation was originally developed.
education: BS in Electrical Engineering, Stanford University
Master's in Electrical Engineering, Stanford University (Dropped Out)

founders.name: Kai Marshland
founders.bio: Kai Marshland co-founded WindBorne Systems after leading the Valbal project at the Stanford Space Initiative, where they broke multiple world records for long-duration balloon flight. Before launching WindBorne, Kai gained industry experience as a flight software intern at SpaceX and a full-stack developer at LeoLabs. Their background is rooted in software engineering and orbital mechanics, having developed mission control software and managed large-scale technical teams during their time at Stanford. Kai’s technical expertise spans embedded systems, full-stack development, and navigating the complexities of atmospheric data collection.
education: B.S. Computer Science, Stanford University
Master's Candidate in Computer Science, Stanford University

founders.name: Andrey Sushko
founders.bio: Before founding WindBorne Systems, Andrey Sushko developed navigational sensors for spacecraft at SpaceX and conducted research at the Pacific Northwest National Lab. As an undergraduate at Stanford, he led a student-led engineering project within the Stanford Student Space Initiative that broke world records for high-altitude balloon flight duration. He later pursued a PhD in Experimental Physics at Harvard as a Hertz and PD Soros Fellow, focusing on quantum systems at the interface of condensed matter and AMO physics. He eventually returned to his record-breaking balloon project to launch WindBorne in 2019, bridging the gap between theoretical physics and atmospheric engineering.
education: PhD in Experimental Physics, Harvard University
BS in Physics, Stanford University
BS in Mathematics, Stanford University

founders.name: Paige Brown
founders.bio: A native of Bangor, Maine, Paige Brown's scientific career began in high school, where she developed a low-cost filtration system for water pollution that won the 2016 Intel Science Talent Search. At Stanford University, she led the Stanford Student Space Initiative and interned at SpaceX, experiences that merged her interests in environmental impact and aerospace. These pre-founding achievements, including being named a Thiel Fellow, culminated in the launch of WindBorne Systems during her undergraduate studies to revolutionize weather data collection.
education: BSc in Materials Science, Stanford University

founders.name: Joan Creus-Costa
founders.bio: Prior to co-founding WindBorne Systems, Joan was a prominent researcher at Stanford University, where he worked in the Stanford Vision Lab under Fei-Fei Li and the Autonomous Systems Lab under Marco Pavone. He was a key member of the Stanford Student Space Initiative (SSI), leading development on the ValBal project, which set world records for high-altitude balloon flight duration. His pre-founding work also included co-authoring research on reinforcement learning frameworks and developing flight simulation tools like 'launchsim' for tracking orbital vehicle trajectories. He officially launched WindBorne in 2019 to commercialize the balloon-based sensing technology developed during his time at SSI.
education: B.S. in Computer Science, Stanford University

founders.name: Tom Plümmer
founders.bio: Before founding Wingcopter, Tom Plümmer spent nearly two years in Ghana working for an NGO, an experience that highlighted the life-threatening gaps in medical supply chains and inspired his pivot from media to humanitarian drone technology. While studying in Germany, he launched his first entrepreneurial venture—a drone service startup focused on aerial photography and filming. In 2015, he met engineer Jonathan Hesselbarth, whose high-performance drone prototypes aligned with Plümmer's vision for long-range medical delivery, leading him to drop out of his Master’s degree to co-found Wingcopter in 2017.
education: BA in Media Management, Hochschule Darmstadt (Mediencampus Dieburg)
Master’s in Leadership in the Creative Industries, Hochschule Darmstadt (Incomplete)
Study Abroad Year, University of Accra (DAAD Scholar)
tags: World Economic Forum Young Global Leader

founders.name: Jonathan Hesselbarth
founders.bio: Hesselbarth grew up in a family of aviation enthusiasts and spent much of his childhood at airfields, beginning to build model aircraft at a young age. While studying mechanical engineering at the Technical University of Darmstadt, he was an active member of the 'Akaflieg' aviation club, where he developed the core tilt-rotor mechanism for vertical take-off and landing. He refined his drone prototypes in his parents' workshop before meeting co-founder Tom Plümmer and officially launching Wingcopter in 2017 to repurpose his inventions for humanitarian and logistical use.
education: Mechanical Engineering, Technical University of Darmstadt (TU Darmstadt)

founders.name: Ansgar Kadura
founders.bio: Ansgar Kadura's path to founding Wingcopter began while he was an industrial engineering student at the Technical University of Darmstadt. After discovering the early drone prototypes developed by Tom Plümmer and Jonathan Hesselbarth through social media, he joined the team as an intern. He played a pivotal role in the company's early success by securing a grant from the German Federal Ministry’s EXIST support program, which provided the foundational capital necessary to officially launch the startup in 2017. His pre-founding experience is rooted in the Darmstadt aerospace ecosystem, where he transitioned from an academic focus on business-engineering to scaling drone service operations.
education: M.Sc. Industrial Engineering, Technical University of Darmstadt
B.Sc. Industrial Engineering, Technical University of Darmstadt

founders.name: Teppo Hemiä
founders.bio: Teppo Hemiä is a veteran of the Finnish telecommunications industry with over 20 years of experience in wireless technology and semiconductors. Before joining Wirepas in 2014, he spent a decade at Nokia in senior roles, including Chief Architect for Portfolio Planning and Chief ASIC Designer. He also served as a Group Vice President at STMicroelectronics and led major business units at ST-Ericsson, specializing in mobile chipset platforms. Under his leadership, Wirepas transitioned from a hardware-focused university spinoff into a leading global provider of decentralized IoT mesh software.
education: Master of Science in Digital and Computer Systems, Tampere University of Technology
Aalto CEO Circle, Aalto University Executive Education

founders.name: Mikko Kohvakka
founders.bio: Before founding Wirepas in 2010, Mikko Kohvakka spent nearly a decade as a researcher and scientist at Tampere University of Technology (TUT). During his time at the Department of Computer Systems, he spearheaded the TUTWSN (Tampere University of Technology Wireless Sensor Network) project, which sought to solve scalability and energy issues in IoT. His extensive academic research into decentralized networking and medium access control (MAC) protocols culminated in a PhD in 2009 and served as the technical foundation for the Wirepas Mesh technology. Kohvakka initially led the company as CEO, successfully spinning the technology out of the university lab and into the global industrial IoT market.
education: PhD in Technology, Tampere University of Technology
Master of Science in Engineering, Tampere University of Technology

founders.name: Ville Juven
founders.bio: Ville Juven was a researcher at Tampere University of Technology (TUT) during the late 2000s, where he focused on massive IoT and wireless sensor networks. In 2010, he co-founded Wirepas as a technical spinoff from TUT to commercialize a decentralized mesh networking protocol. He is a primary architect of the company's technology stack, having authored a Master's thesis specifically on lightweight event-driven real-time operating systems for resource-constrained devices to support the early Wirepas protocol. He remains deeply involved in low-level software development and is an active contributor to the Apache NuttX real-time operating system project.
education: Master of Science in Technology, Tampere University of Technology

founders.name: Ville Kaseva
founders.bio: Before co-founding Wirepas in 2010, Ville Kaseva was a prominent researcher at the Tampere University of Technology (TUT) within the Department of Computer Systems. He was a key member of the DACI (Design, Applications, Communications, Implementations) research group, where he contributed to the decade-long academic project that pioneered decentralized mesh networking. His pre-founding career was dedicated to developing low-power wireless sensor network (WSN) platforms and energy-efficient communication protocols. Kaseva transitioned directly from his academic research role into leadership at Wirepas to commercialize the technology he helped invent.
education: Master of Science in Technology, Tampere University of Technology

founders.name: Udit Poddar
founders.bio: Udit Poddar began his career as a Decision Scientist at Mu Sigma and later served as a Data Scientist at SocialCops (now Atlan) and Quizizz. During his time in the tech sector, he identified a significant digital gap between modern technology companies and traditional heavy industries like mining and manufacturing. This realization led him to co-found Pragyaam Data Technologies in 2017 with childhood friends, eventually evolving the venture into Workongrid, a no-code operations management platform tailored for industrial digital transformation.
education: Bachelor of Science in Economics, St. Xavier's College, Kolkata

founders.name: Shreyansh Jain
founders.bio: Shreyansh Jain is the Founder and COO of Grid (WorkOnGrid), where he focuses on digitizing industrial operations through no-code solutions. He began his career as a Data Scientist at Mu Sigma, gaining extensive experience in data analytics and process optimization for large enterprises. In 2017, he transitioned into entrepreneurship by launching a data consulting firm for SMEs, which served as the precursor to the scalable Grid platform he leads today.
education: Bachelor of Engineering in Mechanical Engineering, RV College of Engineering

founders.name: Aayush Agrawal
founders.bio: Before co-founding WorkOnGrid (now known as Grid), Aayush spent several years as a Data Engineer at major tech companies including LogMeIn and Citrix, where he specialized in managing complex data pipelines. His passion for entrepreneurship was evident early on during his time at RV College of Engineering, where he served as the Vice President of Marketing Operations for the institution's Entrepreneurship Cell. In 2017, he teamed up with his childhood school friends to bridge the digital gap in traditional industries like mining and manufacturing, initially launching a consulting enterprise called Pragyaam Data Technologies that eventually evolved into the Grid platform.
education: Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) in Computer Science, RV College of Engineering

founders.name: Shaurya Poddar
founders.bio: Before co-founding Workongrid, Shaurya Poddar spent nearly three years at Google as an Account Manager and Associate Account Strategist, where he helped high-growth startups and offline businesses expand their digital presence. Coming from a family background in traditional industries like mining and manufacturing, he recognized the technological gap in asset-heavy sectors. This led him to co-found Pragyaam Data Technologies in 2017, a consulting enterprise that eventually evolved into the no-code operations platform known as Grid (Workongrid).
education: Bachelor of Management Studies, St. Xavier's College
